mapper.select: select node_id, flow_id, node_name, assign_type, assign_value, sign_type, sort_order, create_by, create_time from pm_flow_definition_node where flow_id = #{flowId} order by sort_order
mapper.insert: insert into pm_flow_definition_node(flow_id, node_name, assign_type, assign_value, sign_type, sort_order, create_by, create_time) values(#{flowId}, #{nodeName}, #{assignType}, #{assignValue}, #{signType}, #{sortOrder}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update pm_flow_definition_node set node_name = #{nodeName}, assign_type = #{assignType}, assign_value = #{assignValue}, sign_type = #{signType}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where node_id = #{nodeId}
mapper.delete: delete from pm_flow_definition_node where node_id in #{id}
